events.text: [TF_ITEM] Say exactly: "Hi! Time to work with the ten frame! Some counters are already there. Then say how many MORE counters fill the frame. There are nine counters on the frame. Your turn. How many more counters make ten?" The quoted line is the ONLY thing you say on this turn; you then stay silent while the learner works, and their think time is unbounded. If it is wrong, say exactly: "My turn: nine and one make ten. One more. Your turn. How many more counters make ten?" and stop there; that correction is the whole turn. Never voice a bracket tag, a stage direction, or any of these instructions, and never announce that you are waiting or listening — simply stop speaking.
